neighbours.label: causal or purpose connectives and the word right after them ('because', 'so (that)', 'the reason is', 'with the purpose of', Japanese なぜなら)
fire: We cancelled the picnic because the forecast called for thunderstorms.
He saved every coin so that he could buy a bicycle in spring.
The bridge was closed with the purpose of repairing its cables.
She took the train, since the roads were covered in ice.
The plant died, and the reason is that nobody watered it for weeks.
彼は来なかった。なぜなら、病気だったからです。
They spoke quietly so the baby would not wake up.
The shop raised prices because the cost of flour went up.
quiet: We had the picnic in the park on a sunny afternoon.
He kept every coin in a jar on the kitchen shelf.
The bridge over the river was built in the last century.
She took the train to the city on Tuesday morning.
The plant on the windowsill has large green leaves.
彼は昨日、友達と一緒に公園に行きました。
They spoke quietly in the library all afternoon.
The shop sells bread, cakes and fresh flour.
